name: freeform-fields
description: Field group builder for WP Freeform Fields.
author: kiberberik (https://kiberberik.link)

scripts.build: wp-scripts build builder=./assets/src/builder/index.tsx blocks=./assets/src/blocks/index.tsx map=./assets/src/map/index.ts admin=./assets/src/admin/index.ts --output-path=build
scripts.start: wp-scripts start builder=./assets/src/builder/index.tsx blocks=./assets/src/blocks/index.tsx map=./assets/src/map/index.ts admin=./assets/src/admin/index.ts --output-path=build
scripts.i18n: wp i18n make-pot . languages/freeform-fields.pot --slug=freeform-fields --domain=freeform-fields --exclude=.dev,vendor,node_modules,tests,assets/src && wp i18n update-po languages/freeform-fields.pot languages && wp i18n make-mo languages && wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge
